lines: Sempra is updating its full-year 2026 GAAP earnings-per-common share (EPS) guidance range to $7.41 to $8.41, reflecting strong results through the third quarter, guiding to the high end of its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance range of $4.80 to $5.30 and affirming its 2027 EPS guidance range of $5.10 to $5.70.
▪estimated gain on sale of SI Partners ranging from $2.00 billion to $2.40 billion, subject to post-closing adjustments, which we expect to complete in November 2026
